annotations.title: Put a set of App Store app previews in order

description: Sets the order of one app preview set (one language and device size, up to 3): setId and every preview id of the set, each once, first to last, from ploa_listing_get with that language. Needs a token allowed to submit.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
